desc: 金属腔体入耳佩戴、透明耳帽复合振膜、多芯铜线线材

name: 铝合金腔体有线入耳耳机款

shots.intent: 在搜索结果里用高反差金属质感与冷蓝轮廓光一眼抢点击，同时抛出核心听感主张。
shots.textZone: top-centre headline band with two sub-labels and a three-dot pager beneath

shots.intent: 把六个核心卖点压成一屏图标墙，滑动即读全，替代长篇参数说明。
shots.textZone: eyebrow line and pill button in the top band, centred headline, six icon labels in a 3x2 grid

shots.intent: 用侧面微距证明金属腔体加工纹理与透声耳帽的内部结构，建立做工信任。
用无脸耳模演示入耳佩戴位置与贴合度，解决胀痛与掉落疑虑。
shots.textZone: headline centred under the top band, two stacked circular line icons with labels in the left column

shots.intent: 把发声单元沿轴炸开，用结构解释低音从哪来，替代空喊音效口号。
shots.textZone: headline above the stack with one short sub-label beneath it

shots.intent: 剥开外皮露出多股导体与双色内芯，用可拍到的材料细节支撑线材耐用卖点。
shots.textZone: two hairline leader lines with open-circle terminators down the right side

shots.intent: 用曲线图版承接调音主张，把信任落在可核对的图形证据而不是口号上。
shots.textZone: chart title at the panel head and one caption under the curve

shots.intent: 用线稿与标注条回答腔体大小与佩戴尺度问题，降低尺寸不确定。
shots.textZone: centred section title, two dimension labels at the ends of hairline dimension bars

shots.intent: 一次呈现三种配色与随附耳帽配件，让买家完成选色并看清到手清单。
shots.textZone: one short label under each row item

shots.intent: 以暗调金属质感收口，把已建立的听感与做工信任转成一个动作。
shots.textZone: headline in the upper clear space, rounded CTA button centred below the product

style.backgroundSystem: alternating deep space-blue-black studio void panels with a matte fine-grain charcoal stone floor, and flat cool off-white infographic panels; one accent glow band only
